recepciones.confirmarAyuda: Check the quantities. Confirming adds the products to the warehouse and this receipt can no longer be edited.
recepciones.cancelarAyuda: This draft will no longer be available for editing or confirmation. It has not created any stock.
recepciones.confirmadaAyuda: Stock entry recorded. Lots retain actual quantities and their link to this receipt.
recepciones.canceladaAyuda: This draft was cancelled and did not create stock.
recepciones.listaAyuda: Review quantities and units before confirming. Pending purchase quantities will be checked again when recording the entry.
recepciones.completarAyuda: Complete the draft with received and measured quantities greater than zero to confirm the entry.
recepciones.datosIngresoAyuda: Choose the destination and enter what arrived. You can review and confirm at the end.
recepciones.notasAyuda: Add a clarification only if needed.
recepciones.motivoIngresoAyuda: For example: opening stock or returned goods. Complete before confirming.
recepciones.motivoIngresoObligatorio: Briefly explain why these products are entering without a purchase.
recepciones.anotarLlegadaAyuda: Enter only what arrived today. Rows left blank will remain pending.
recepciones.directoProductosAyuda: Add the products and enter the quantity that will enter the warehouse.
recepciones.eligeCompraPrimero: Choose a purchase to automatically see products still to be received.
recepciones.errorProductos: We could not load the products. Your entered quantities are kept.
recepciones.sinPendientesFiltro: No pending products match this search.
recepciones.sinAnotados: No products entered yet. Enter quantities for what arrived or add a product without a purchase.
recepciones.productoNoDisponible: Inactive product or catalog. Cannot be received.
recepciones.lineasAnotadas: {cantidad, plural, one {# line entered} other {# lines entered}}
recepciones.revisionIngresoAyuda: Confirming adds these quantities to the warehouse. You can receive the rest of the purchase later. A confirmed receipt cannot be edited.
recepciones.cantidadPositiva: Enter a quantity greater than zero or clear this line.
recepciones.cantidadSuperaPendiente: The arrived quantity cannot exceed what remains to be received from the purchase.
recepciones.cantidadesDebenCoincidir: When using the same unit, arrived and warehouse quantities must match.
recepciones.sinLineasConfirmar: Enter at least one product before reviewing the receipt.
recepciones.limiteLineas: You can enter up to 500 lines in a receipt.
recepciones.revisarCampos: Check the highlighted fields before continuing.
recepciones.borradorEnHoja: Draft saved. Keep entering quantities or review the receipt.
recepciones.borradorSinEdicion: Draft saved. Your role can review and confirm it but cannot edit it.
recepciones.descartarSalidaAyuda: Leaving now will lose anything entered since the last save.
recepciones.descartarRecargaAyuda: Current data will be loaded and your unsaved changes discarded.

inventario.lotesAyuda: View actual quantities by lot, unit and warehouse. Blocked or expired lots keep their balance but are unavailable for preparation.
inventario.movimientosAyuda: Each confirmed stock entry is linked to its receipt and lots. Quantities are shown in their own unit.
inventario.movimientoAyuda: Stock entry recorded when confirming a receipt. Quantities and source are retained in inventory history.
inventario.unidadesAyuda: Enable units used to measure this product on arrival. Its base unit is always included. Purchase presentations do not define conversions.
inventario.cambiarUnidadAyuda: This change affects new measurements and draft confirmations. Existing lots and movements retain their units and quantities.
inventario.errorCarga: Data could not be loaded. Check that it exists and try again.
inventario.conflicto: The record has changed or the operation is no longer available. Reload before continuing.
inventario.restringido: You do not have permission to perform this operation.
inventario.validacion: Review the highlighted data before continuing.
inventario.bloqueoAyuda: Blocking prevents the lot from being used in preparation and retains its physical balance. When unblocked, its expiry date, product, unit and warehouse must also remain valid.
inventario.vencidoAyuda: Expired lot: physical stock is retained and is unavailable for preparation.
inventario.bloqueadoAyuda: Blocked lot: physical stock is retained and is unavailable for preparation.
inventario.disponibleAyuda: Stock available for upcoming preparation processes.
inventario.noDisponibleAyuda: This stock is unavailable. Check that the product, category, unit and warehouse are active.
inventario.movimientoPreparacionAyuda: Movement recorded when confirming a preparation. Retains the source operation and actual quantities by lot and unit.
inventario.aprovechableAyuda: Stock separated and held for production. Its balance is retained and is unavailable for order preparation.

cajillas.subtitulo: Track your crates by colour: available in warehouses, sent to branches and awaiting return.
cajillas.nuevoColorAyuda: Register each colour once and enter the number of crates you own. You can then record stock additions, deliveries and returns from its details page.
cajillas.cantidadInicialAyuda: You can start at zero and add stock later.
cajillas.soloRegistrarColor: Your permission allows you to register the colour. Adding stock requires stock entry permission.
cajillas.sinColores: Register a colour to start tracking crates.
cajillas.fechaAutomatica: The creation date and responsible user are recorded automatically.
cajillas.colorGuardado: Colour and opening stock recorded successfully.
cajillas.restringido: You do not have permission to perform this crate operation.
cajillas.errorCarga: Could not load the data. Check that it exists and try again.
cajillas.errorGuardar: Could not record the operation. Review the highlighted fields and try again.
cajillas.validacion: Review the highlighted data before continuing.
cajillas.conflicto: Balances changed or the operation key was already used. Check the history and reload balances before continuing.
cajillas.conflictoCreacion: This operation key was already used with different data. Check the colour list before registering again.
cajillas.cantidadInvalida: Enter a whole number from zero to 2147483647.
cajillas.cantidadPositiva: Enter a whole number greater than zero, up to 2147483647.
cajillas.cantidadAyuda: Enter the actual number of crates as a whole number.
cajillas.superaSaldo: The quantity cannot exceed the balance of {cantidad} crates.
cajillas.descartarAyuda: The data in this form has not been recorded yet.

ayudas.ingreso: Add new crates of this colour to the receiving warehouse. The total number of crates will increase.
ayudas.salida: Enter how many crates leave the warehouse and which branch receives them. They will remain outstanding until returned.
ayudas.devolucion: Record crates returned by a branch and the receiving warehouse. The total stays the same and the outstanding balance decreases.

cajillas.sinExistencias: There are no crates available in warehouses.
cajillas.sinPendientes: There are no outstanding crate returns.
cajillas.recargarAyuda: Quantity and notes will be kept. Choose the warehouse and branch again to review their balances.
cajillas.confirmarAyuda: Review the colour, quantity and destination. Confirming updates the balances and preserves these details in the history.
cajillas.saldosAlmacenesAyuda: See where crates of this colour are located. Quantities at inactive warehouses are retained for tracking.
cajillas.saldosSucursalesAyuda: These branches have outstanding crates of this colour. You can record partial returns.
cajillas.sinSaldosAlmacenes: There are no crates of this colour in warehouses.

preparaciones.subtitulo: Group daily orders by customer and branch. Prepare from available lots and record actual quantities and weights.
preparaciones.jornadaAyuda: Choose the required order date and customer. The worksheet groups their branches and retains requested and outstanding quantities.
preparaciones.seleccionarClienteFecha: Choose a date and customer to see their consolidated orders.
preparaciones.matrizAyuda: Each column represents a branch. Totals include all customer branches, including those on other pages.
preparaciones.errorHoja: The worksheet is unavailable or has changed. Reload to view current data.
preparaciones.leyendaCantUni: CANT: requested boxes. UNI: separate unit quantities. These are order quantities; actual weights are recorded separately.
preparaciones.sinPedidosFiltro: No ordered products match these filters.
preparaciones.sinPreparaciones: No recorded preparations match these filters.
preparaciones.borradorAyuda: A draft saves your work without reserving or deducting stock. Confirmation checks balances, quality and outstanding quantities again.
preparaciones.lotesAyuda: Add the lots you will use. During allocation, record each lot’s actual contribution to each order. Here you can separate waste or recoverable stock in the lot’s unit.
preparaciones.sinLotes: Choose a warehouse and product, then add available lots.
preparaciones.saldoAlConfirmar: The current balance will be checked again at confirmation.
preparaciones.utilizadaAyuda: Sum of actual allocations, waste and recoverable stock from this lot.
preparaciones.aprovechableAyuda: Recoverable stock retains its quantity in a separate lot held for production. Waste and recoverable stock do not fulfil ordered quantities.
preparaciones.repartoAyuda: Record prepared CANT or UNI separately from each lot’s actual contribution. Several lots can fulfil one order quantity. Kilograms are not inferred from requested boxes or units.
preparaciones.sinAsignaciones: No quantities have been allocated yet. Fill in daily outstanding quantities to add allocations.
preparaciones.sinPendientes: There are no outstanding quantities for this filter.
preparaciones.origenAsignacionCambio: The order has changed or is no longer available. Review outstanding quantities or remove this draft allocation.
preparaciones.agregarLoteProducto: First add a lot of this product in the “Lots and quality” step.
preparaciones.pesoConfirmar: Record the measured weight. It is required to confirm this allocation.
preparaciones.cajillasAyuda: Enter the crates you plan to send by branch and color. This is a plan only; crates have not left the warehouse yet.
preparaciones.revisarCajillas: Choose a branch, colour and valid positive whole quantity.
preparaciones.sinCajillasPrevistas: You can add the crates you plan to use for each branch.
preparaciones.revisionAyuda: Review prepared quantities and actual usage. Confirming deducts the quantity used from the warehouse.
preparaciones.lotesMediciones: What was used from the warehouse
preparaciones.repartoSucursal: What was prepared for each branch
preparaciones.decimalInvalido: Enter a non-negative quantity with up to three decimal places and eleven whole digits.
preparaciones.enteroInvalido: Enter a whole quantity within the allowed range.
preparaciones.motivoObligatorio: Describe the reason for the quality separation.
preparaciones.cantidadSuperaPendiente: The prepared quantity cannot exceed the {cantidad} outstanding for this line.
preparaciones.cambiarAlmacenAyuda: Changing the warehouse clears this draft’s lots and allocations. Review the planned crates afterwards.
preparaciones.confirmarAyuda: Confirming deducts the stock used and updates what has been prepared for each branch. You cannot edit this preparation afterwards.
preparaciones.cancelarAyuda: This draft will no longer be available for preparation. Its history is retained and it creates no inventory movements.
preparaciones.confirmarCajillasAviso: Crates remain planned; their delivery to branches belongs to dispatch.
preparaciones.confirmada: Preparation confirmed. Inventory and order progress updated.
preparaciones.confirmadaAyuda: Movements have been recorded. Fully fulfilled orders become prepared; outstanding quantities remain tracked.
preparaciones.canceladaAyuda: This preparation was cancelled as a draft and created no movements.
preparaciones.soloBorrador: Only draft preparations can be edited.
preparaciones.pedidoBloqueado: This order has confirmed prepared quantities. Its request is retained to preserve inventory and outstanding quantity traceability.
preparaciones.impresionAyuda: All filtered products and branches will be loaded. Printing separates categories and groups up to four branches per block for readability.
preparaciones.impresionCambio: A consistent worksheet could not be completed. Orders may have changed. Reload all data before printing.
preparaciones.totalTodasSucursales: The customer total includes all their branches.
preparaciones.restringido: You do not have permission to perform this preparation operation.
preparaciones.errorCarga: Could not load the data. Check that it exists and try again.
preparaciones.errorGuardar: Could not save. Review the highlighted fields before continuing.
preparaciones.validacion: Review the highlighted data before continuing.
preparaciones.conflicto: Data changed or this operation was already recorded with other data. Reload and review before continuing.
preparaciones.eligeProductoAyuda: Choose a product to see its branches and enter prepared quantities. Switching products keeps your data.
preparaciones.sinProductosFiltro: No pending products match these filters.
preparaciones.sinProductosAnotados: No lots selected or quantities entered for these products yet.
preparaciones.lotesProductoAyuda: Choose the lot to use. Those expiring sooner appear first. Selecting a lot does not deduct stock.
preparaciones.eligeLoteParaMedir: Choose a lot here or in a branch row to enter how much you used.
preparaciones.eligeAlmacenParaLotes: Choose the warehouse first to see available lots.
preparaciones.huboSeparacionCalidad: Was any product damaged or set aside for another use?
preparaciones.otroUsoAyudaTrabajo: Explain the reason if you separated a quantity. Product intended for another use is stored separately and unavailable for orders.
preparaciones.pedidoNoDisponibleTrabajo: This order changed or has nothing pending. Check your entries or remove it from this preparation.
preparaciones.elegirLoteSucursalAyuda: Choose a lot and enter what you actually weighed or counted.
preparaciones.quePreparasSucursalTrabajo: What are you preparing for each branch?
preparaciones.repartoProductoAyuda: Enter only what you are preparing. Boxes (CANT) and Units (UNI) are separate. The quantity used from the lot must be an actual measurement.
preparaciones.resumenProductosSucursalesTrabajo: {productos, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} · {sucursales, plural, one {# branch} other {# branches}}
preparaciones.cambiarAlmacenTrabajoAyuda: Lots, quantities and crates entered in this worksheet will be cleared to work with the new warehouse.
preparaciones.quitarLoteTrabajoAyuda: Measurements and separated quantities from this lot will be cleared. Prepared quantities will remain so you can specify another source lot.
preparaciones.recargarTrabajoAyuda: Current data will be loaded and anything entered since the last save discarded.
preparaciones.salirTrabajoAyuda: Leaving now will lose anything entered since the last save.
preparaciones.limiteFilasTrabajo: A preparation allows up to 500 lots, order lines and crate rows.
preparaciones.anotaSucursalParaRevisarTrabajo: Enter prepared quantities for at least one branch before reviewing.
preparaciones.cantidadPositivaTrabajo: Enter a quantity greater than zero or remove this row if unused.
preparaciones.faltanMedicionesTrabajo: Choose a lot and enter how much you used for this prepared quantity.
preparaciones.faltaPesoTrabajo: Enter the actual measured weight in kg.
preparaciones.superaSaldoTrabajo: Usage exceeds the lot's visible balance. Check measurements.
preparaciones.loteNoValidoTrabajo: Choose a lot for this product to record the measurement.
preparaciones.revisaDatosTrabajo: Check the highlighted fields before continuing.
preparaciones.prepararPorProductoAyuda: Work product by product, enter prepared quantities and review before confirming.
preparaciones.borradorGuardadoTrabajo: Draft saved. Keep preparing or review.
preparaciones.borradorSinEdicionTrabajo: Draft saved. Your role can review and confirm it but cannot edit it.
preparaciones.loteSinUsoTrabajo: This batch is unused. Enter the measured quantities for the branches or remove it from the preparation.
